name: Turn YouTube and Bilibili videos into a blog post, X thread and LinkedIn post with Claude via apimodels.app

parameters.content:
## Turn a video into a blog post, X thread and LinkedIn post

Paste a YouTube or Bilibili link and get a ready-to-edit blog post, an X thread, a LinkedIn post, a newsletter blurb and an optional 16:9 cover image. The subtitles, the writing (Claude Sonnet 5.5) and the cover (GPT Image 2) all come from one API key on [apimodels.app](https://apimodels.app), so there is no separate transcript service to sign up for.

### How it works
1. The form takes the video link, output language, tone and whether to make a cover.
2. **Get subtitles** lists the video's caption tracks; **Pick subtitle track** prefers human captions in the spoken language.
3. The captions are downloaded and cleaned into plain text.
4. Claude writes every format in one call and returns JSON.
5. If requested, GPT Image 2 draws a cover with the headline on it.
6. The result page shows everything in copy-ready boxes plus the real cost of the run.

### Setup
1. Create an API key in the [apimodels console](https://apimodels.app/console/api-keys). New accounts get $0.1 of free credit.
2. Create a **Bearer Auth** credential with that key and select it in the three apimodels HTTP Request nodes.
3. Activate the workflow and open the production form URL from the trigger node.
Step-by-step guide: [apimodels.app/docs/n8n](https://apimodels.app/docs/n8n)

### Customize
- Change the writing model or transcript limit in **Settings**.
- Edit lengths and formats in the system message of **Write posts**.
- Only videos with captions work (most YouTube videos have auto-generated ones).

## 1. Get the transcript
Lists caption tracks, picks the best one, downloads and cleans it.

## 2. Write and illustrate
One Claude call writes all formats as JSON; GPT Image 2 makes the cover if asked.

## 3. Result pages
Copy-ready text with the run's cost, or the provider's own error message.
